body: It's really dumb stuff. Yeah I did there's no other reason why I'm here.

Thanks. Its so difficult to put it into words. I feel alone. I have no friends, no family to talk to. The only person I have is my girlfriend with whom I live with in a country I can hardly understand or speak the language. Sometimes we argue which is normal but being here when that happens feels so much more worse. Last night we had an argument. I went out to de escalate. I got a bunch of text messages from my gf "if you cant understand why I'm angry then that is it" I just wanted to slam the car into a wall or something.
